label: California: home solicitation and home improvement contracts
summary: California's home solicitation rules (Civil Code 1689.5 to 1689.14) and home improvement contract rules (Business and Professions Code 7159), layered on the federal standard for a job whose address is in California. Three business days to cancel, five when any buyer is 65 or older, seven for repairs after a declared disaster; cancellation by email; the down payment limit; and the items the contract's first page must carry. Where California gives the buyer more, its rule applies (16 CFR 429.2).
not_legal_advice: This pack is a starting point drawn from public law, not legal advice. Have your own lawyer review it, and your agreement template, before any customer signs.
